Paper Name: Multi-criteria optimal sizing and analysis of PV/wind/fuel cell/battery/diesel generator for rural electrification: A case study in Chad
NOTES: Paper uses MOPSO algorithm (MATLAB R2023b). Reports LOLP (0%) instead of LPSP — similar but not identical parameter. Reports LCOE (0.2982 $/kWh) but does not use term 'COE'. Battery: 1.35 kWh per unit (Table 2). Yearly avoided CO2: 374,640 kg. RES fraction: 100% (83% solar, 17% wind). NPC: 2,298,500 $. Interest rate: 10%. Wind turbine AG=0.246 L/kWh, BG=0.0845 L/kWh. DG lifetime reported in hours (43800 h) not years. Component counts not explicitly stated except H2 tanks (144). Number of PV panels, wind turbines, FC, EL, DG units not explicitly given — only total capacities reported.
